label: STAGE-0 SIZE GATE (synthetic nulls; corpus pools are seen, label-based Stage-0 planning inputs)
rule: flagged if the lower limit of the two-sided 95 % Clopper-Pearson interval (one-sided 97.5 %; P2's convention) of the size > 0.035 at nominal one-sided 0.025
seed_scheme: numpy default_rng(paths.seed_for(seed_key)), seed_for(k) = 20261023 + crc32(k); seed_key per row
disclosure: Corpus pools (unit chords, P1 family log ratios) are seen label-based values used only as planning null distributions (recentred to the null); they assume new laboratories resemble corpus units, which the supply does not (P4: 15 of 16 new laboratories on absent chemotypes).
notes: The raw t-interval is location-invariant, so CGD_R / GDT_R sizes do not depend on beta; CGD_W does (fixed clip bounds), and must be rerun if beta_frozen differs from the value used.
Under parametric nulls GDT_R equals CGD_R on identical draws; GDT_R decides only at G >= 10, so only the G = 13 composition and the i.i.d. G = 10, 13 cells are decidable for it.
The C-ECT emp_P1 (right-skewed) and emp_P1_mirror (left-skewed) rows are descriptive: skewed nulls are non-gating (brief 4.2), and like every test here the sign-flip does not hold 0.025 under them.
Two-stage cells put each laboratory in one chemotype (worst case for a Gd-dip laboratory value averaged across chemotypes).
C-ECT sign-flip and SIGN are scale-free; the family-level p (I2 confirm-4 item 6) is not re-run here.
Not covered: C-GD's secondary per-unit Gd-pair SSE sign-flip and the A3 positive control.
